data.taskBrief:
TASK BRIEF: Send a transactional email to a customer using the Sendinblue API (Sendinblue)

FIT
  Fully. The supplied request sends a transactional email to one or more recipients, including the sender, recipient, and optional template selection. No supplied requests are irrelevant.

AUTH
  API-key authentication
  Header: api-key: <Sendinblue API key>. The collection references the credential as {{send_in_blue_api_key}}; provide its actual value.

BASE URL
  https://api.sendinblue.com/v3

STEPS
  1. POST /smtp/email
     Params (JSON body):
       sender: object — {"name":"Mary from MyShop","email":"no-reply@myshop.com"}; place in the body and use the sender identity that is authorized by Sendinblue.
       sender.name: string — 'Mary from MyShop'; nested in sender.
       sender.email: string — 'no-reply@myshop.com'; nested in sender.
       to: array of recipient objects — [{"email":"customer@example.com","name":"Customer"}]; place in the body.
       to[].email: string — 'customer@example.com'; nested in each to item.
       to[].name: string — 'Customer'; nested in each to item.
       templateId: integer — 69; place in the body when using a Sendinblue template.
       Also accepts: bcc, cc, htmlContent, textContent, subject, replyTo, attachment, headers, params, messageVersions, tags, scheduledAt, batchId — see the request schema for details.
       Headers: Content-Type: application/json and Accept: application/json.
     Returns:
       201 Created or 202 Accepted with messageId (string) in the response body; a 200 OK example has an empty body. A 400 Bad Request example returns code (string) and message (string).
     Threading:
       None

GOTCHAS
  - Send the body as JSON and include the api-key header; the request's collection does not provide an actual API-key value.
  - Replace the sample recipient, sender, and templateId with values appropriate for the customer and authorized Sendinblue account.
  - The endpoint supports immediate or scheduled transactional delivery based on the supplied body fields; the examples show 201, 202, and 200 responses, so handle responses with and without a messageId.
  - A 400 example reports method_not_allowed even though it uses POST; verify the resolved base URL is exactly https://api.sendinblue.com/v3 and that the final path is /smtp/email.
